## Summary
Build a multi-step institution setup wizard that creates the institution record, assigns the first admin role, and redirects to the admin dashboard — the entry point for all admin functionality.

## User story
As a platform admin, I want to create my institution and be assigned as its first admin, so that I can begin inviting faculty and managing the platform.

## Why this matters
Without an institution record, RLS policies have no institution_id to scope against. Every downstream feature (faculty invite, dashboard, audit log) requires a valid institution context. If the setup wizard fails silently or creates partial records, the entire admin panel is broken.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Setup wizard collects institution name, type (medical school), and admin contact info
- [ ] Institution + admin profile are created atomically via supabase.rpc() (not sequential inserts)
- [ ] After setup, user's profile.role is set to 'admin' and profile.institution_id is populated
- [ ] Wizard redirects to /dashboard on success
- [ ] If institution already exists for this user, redirect to /dashboard (no duplicate creation)
- [ ] Form validation: institution name required (3-100 chars), valid institution type
- [ ] Error state shown on wizard if RPC fails (network error, constraint violation)

## Canonical decisions in play
| Rule | What it means for this story |
|---|---|
| Data Layer (AP-17) | supabase.rpc() for atomic institution + profile creation — never sequential .insert() |
| Data Layer (AP-16) | Row<'institutions'>, Row<'profiles'> from @journey/db/client |
| Atomic Design | SetupWizard is an organism in features/admin/components/, page.tsx < 30 lines |
| RLS | Institution created with id, admin profile linked — all future queries scoped by institution_id |
| Rule 6 (G08) | If Neo4j institution node needed later, Supabase write first, Neo4j second |

## Schema changes
```sql
-- institutions table
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.institutions (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  name TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (char_length(name) BETWEEN 3 AND 100),
  institution_type TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'medical_school',
  settings JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

ALTER TABLE public.institutions ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
CREATE POLICY "Admins can read own institution"
  ON public.institutions FOR SELECT
  USING (id = (SELECT institution_id FROM public.profiles WHERE id = auth.uid()));

-- Atomic setup RPC
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.setup_institution(
  p_name TEXT,
  p_institution_type TEXT DEFAULT 'medical_school'
)
RETURNS UUID
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_institution_id UUID;
BEGIN
  -- Create institution
  INSERT INTO public.institutions (name, institution_type)
  VALUES (p_name, p_institution_type)
  RETURNING id INTO v_institution_id;

  -- Update caller's profile to admin of this institution
  UPDATE public.profiles
  SET institution_id = v_institution_id, role = 'admin', updated_at = now()
  WHERE id = auth.uid();

  RETURN v_institution_id;
END;
$$;
```

## API contract
```
POST /app/api/admin/institutions
Headers: Authorization: Bearer [token]
Request: { name: string, institution_type?: string }
Response 200: { data: { institution_id: string }, error: null }
Response 400: { data: null, error: { code: 'VALIDATION_ERROR', message: string } }
Response 401: { data: null, error: { code: 'UNAUTHORIZED', message: 'Not authenticated' } }
Response 409: { data: null, error: { code: 'ALREADY_EXISTS', message: 'Institution already exists for this user' } }
```

## Code patterns to follow
```typescript
// features/admin/repositories/InstitutionRepository.ts
import { createServerClient, Row } from '@journey/db/client';

type Institution = Row<'institutions'>;

export class InstitutionRepository {
  async setupInstitution(name: string, type: string = 'medical_school'): Promise<string> {
    const supabase = createServerClient();
    // AP-17: atomic multi-table via RPC
    const { data, error } = await supabase.rpc('setup_institution', {
      p_name: name,
      p_institution_type: type,
    });
    if (error) throw error;
    return data as string;
  }
}

// app/(admin)/setup/page.tsx — must be < 30 lines
import { SetupWizard } from '@/features/admin/components/SetupWizard';
export default function SetupPage() {
  return <SetupWizard />;
}
```

## Code patterns to AVOID
```typescript
// ✗ AP-17: Sequential inserts for atomic operations
const { data: inst } = await supabase.from('institutions').insert({ name });
const { data: profile } = await supabase.from('profiles').update({ institution_id: inst.id }); // BANNED
// ✓ Use: supabase.rpc('setup_institution', { p_name: name })

// ✗ AP-16: Hand-written interfaces
interface Institution { id: string; name: string; } // BANNED — use Row<'institutions'>
```

## Automated tests (Playwright — runs during /validate)
```typescript
// tests/E02/E02-S02.api.test.ts
import { test, expect } from '@playwright/test';

test('POST /api/admin/institutions creates institution atomically', async ({ request }) => {
  // Requires authenticated session from E02-S01 test helpers
  const res = await request.post('/api/admin/institutions', {
    data: { name: 'Morehouse School of Medicine', institution_type: 'medical_school' }
  });
  expect(res.status()).toBe(200);
  const body = await res.json();
  expect(body.data.institution_id).toBeTruthy();
});

test('POST /api/admin/institutions rejects duplicate setup', async ({ request }) => {
  // Second call for same user should return 409
  const res = await request.post('/api/admin/institutions', {
    data: { name: 'Duplicate Institution' }
  });
  expect(res.status()).toBe(409);
});

test('POST /api/admin/institutions validates name length', async ({ request }) => {
  const res = await request.post('/api/admin/institutions', {
    data: { name: 'ab' } // too short
  });
  expect(res.status()).toBe(400);
  const body = await res.json();
  expect(body.error.code).toBe('VALIDATION_ERROR');
});

test('POST /api/admin/institutions returns 401 when unauthenticated', async ({ request }) => {
  // No auth cookie/header
  const res = await request.post('/api/admin/institutions', {
    data: { name: 'Test Institution' }
  });
  expect(res.status()).toBe(401);
});

// tests/E02/E02-S02.ui.test.ts
import { test, expect } from '@playwright/test';

test('Setup wizard renders institution form', async ({ page }) => {
  // Assumes authenticated session via test fixture
  await page.goto('/setup');
  await expect(page.getByRole('heading', { name: /set up.*institution/i })).toBeVisible();
  await expect(page.getByLabel(/institution name/i)).toBeVisible();
  await expect(page.getByRole('button', { name: /create/i })).toBeVisible();
});

test('Setup wizard validates required fields', async ({ page }) => {
  await page.goto('/setup');
  await page.getByRole('button', { name: /create/i }).click();
  await expect(page.getByText(/required/i)).toBeVisible();
});
```

## Rollback procedure
If implementation fails mid-way:
1. `DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS public.setup_institution; DROP TABLE IF EXISTS public.institutions CASCADE;`
2. No Neo4j changes to revert.
3. `git stash && git checkout develop`
